sn13.5:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso mahāpaṭhaviyā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya.
sn13.5:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā yā vā mahāpaṭhavīti.
sn13.5:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittāti.
